info.description: Robust backend API service for Maiora System built with Go and Chi router.
info.title: Maiora System Backend API

post.description: Authenticates user with username and password

get.description: Retrieves the profile information of the currently authenticated user

post.description: Exchanges a valid refresh token for a newly rotated access token and refresh token pair
Registers a new user account with a unique username and securely hashed password

400.description: Invalid request input or validation error

get.description: Retrieves all product categories ordered alphabetically

post.description: Creates a new product category with automated or custom slug
Creates an import batch, line items, and auto-populates inventory batches in a single transaction

400.description: Invalid request payload or validation error

get.description: Retrieves list of all variants/SKUs (ideal for Import Batch search/dropdowns)
Retrieves paginated list of products with optional search and category filter

post.description: Creates a new product catalog item with optional inline variants

get.description: Retrieves full product details including category and variants

post.description: Creates a new SKU variant for an existing product
post.summary: Add a variant to a product

get.description: Retrieves paginated history of all stock opname audits with optional status and date filters

parameters.description: Filter by status (PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELLED)
parameters.name: status

post.description: Randomly samples product variants from inventory and generates a stock opname audit session for today
post.summary: Generate daily random cycle count assignment

201.description: Stock opname generated or active retrieved

get.description: Retrieves the active stock opname cycle count session scheduled for today
get.summary: Get today's active stock opname assignment

404.description: No active stock opname found for today

get.description: Retrieves detailed information and all audited line items of a stock opname session
get.summary: Get stock opname session by ID

post.description: Marks stock opname session as COMPLETED, calculates total discrepancy, and records completion timestamp
post.summary: Finalize and complete stock opname session

post.description: Records physical inventory counts for items in an active stock opname session and calculates discrepancies
post.summary: Submit physical counts for stock opname items

404.description: Stock opname or item not found
